(Currently Amended) Claim 1: A system for identifying malicious threats on a network comprising: a computing device including a processor coupled to a system memory, the system memory storing instructions for execution on the processor, the instructions configured to cause the processor to: retrieve network data associated with at least one of an IP address or a domain; analyze the network data to identify a malicious network threat; and perform a mitigating action to neutralize the malicious network threat, wherein the computing device is configured to perform said retrieving, analyzing, and performing steps using a specific set of algorithms to obtain actionable intelligence from the network data.

(Currently Amended) Claim 5: The system of claim 1, wherein the instructions are further configured to cause the processor to push a notification, wherein the notification includes the mitigating action for the malicious network threat and is transmitted through a secure communication channel to a third party device.

(Currently Amended) Claim 10: A method for identifying malicious threats on a network comprising: retrieving network data associated with at least one of an IP address or a domain; analyzing the network data to identify a malicious network threat; and performing a mitigating action to neutralize the malicious network threat, wherein the analyzing step comprises applying a machine learning model to classify the malicious network threat based on predefined criteria. 

(Currently Amended) Claim 14: The method of claim 10, further comprising pushing a notification, wherein the notification includes the mitigating action for the malicious network threat and is transmitted through a secure communication channel to a third party device.
